<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

`fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask` copies the conv windows of the accepted speculative-decode steps into the mamba conv-state pool. The source side already goes through the view's strides, because the per-step windows are overlapping, non-contiguous views. The destination side assumed every pool entry is contiguous in `(dim, K-1)` order. It addressed the destination with a flat element index and rejected anything else with `_require_entry_contiguous_dst`.

That assumption blocks pools whose conv state is stored channel-contiguous, that is, as `[K-1, dim]` storage viewed as `[dim, K-1]`. This layout lets a backend's conv kernels read the window along the channel dimension. Such a pool is not entry-contiguous, so speculative decoding (NEXTN/MTP) hit the assert.

Contiguous pools give the same result, because the strides reduce to the old flat index. No backend or flag changes.

## Modifications

The kernel now takes the destination's `dim` and `K-1` strides and addresses the destination exactly as it does the source. The entry-contiguous assert is removed, since the kernel is correct for any strides.

`test_channel_contiguous_dst` scatters into a transposed pool with both the single-layer and the multi-layer entry points. It compares against a reference with `atol=0`, including a masked row (`step_idx < 0`).

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

     and step ``t``'s window is the slice ``shared[:, t:t+K-1]``. That window is

-    destination conv-state row stays contiguous in ``(dim, K-1)`` order.
+    destination is indexed through its ``(dim, K-1)`` strides as well.
     """

+    )
 
     data = tl.load(src_ptr + src_off, mask=mask, other=0.0)

 def fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask(

     overlapping ``as_strided`` view over a shared ``[..., dim, D+K-2]`` buffer,

     ``(dim, win)`` elements through the view's strides instead of flat-copying.
-    ``dst`` (the real conv-state pool) is the usual contiguous
-    ``[layers, cache, dim, K-1]``.
+    ``dst`` (the real conv-state pool) is ``[layers, cache, dim, K-1]``, indexed
+    through its strides (XPU stores it channel-contiguous).
     """
     total_requests = step_indices_raw.shape[0]
     if total_requests == 0 or dst.numel() == 0:
@@ -533,11 +539,6 @@ def fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask(

-
     dst_indices_raw = dst_indices_raw.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
     step_indices_raw = step_indices_raw.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
     src_indices_raw = _prepare_src_rows(src_indices_raw, step_indices_raw)

         )

@@ -693,12 +705,6 @@ def _conv_multi_eligible(pairs) -> bool:

             return False
-        # The descriptor carries layer/slot strides. Only the trailing
-        # feature block is flat-copied, including for unified pool views.
-        if (dst.shape[3] != 1 and dst.stride(3) != 1) or (
-            dst.shape[2] != 1 and dst.stride(2) != dst.shape[3]
-        ):
-            return False
         if src.shape[1:3] != pairs[0][1].shape[1:3]:
             return False
         if dst.shape[1] != pairs[0][0].shape[1]:

@@ -455,6 +455,32 @@ def _steps(n):
         for i, (exp, (got, _)) in enumerate(zip(expect, pairs)):
             torch.testing.assert_close(got, exp, msg=f"conv type {i} mismatch")
 
+    def test_channel_contiguous_dst(self):
+        """XPU keeps conv states as [win, dim] storage viewed as [dim, win]."""
+        torch.manual_seed(13)
+        layers, slots, batch, steps, dim, km1 = 2, 16, 5, 3, 24, 3
+        dst = torch.randn(
+            layers, slots, km1, dim, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE
+        ).transpose(-1, -2)
+        src = torch.randn(
+            layers, batch, steps, dim, km1, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE
+        )
+        dst_idx = torch.randperm(slots, device=DEVICE)[:batch]
+        step_idx = torch.randint(0, steps, (batch,), device=DEVICE)
+        step_idx[0] = -1
+        valid = step_idx >= 0
+        expect = dst.clone()
+        expect[:, dst_idx[valid]] = src[:, valid.nonzero().flatten(), step_idx[valid]]
+
+        got_single = dst.clone().transpose(-1, -2).contiguous().transpose(-1, -2)
+        fused_conv_window_scatter_with_mask(got_single, src, dst_idx, step_idx)
+        got_multi = dst.clone().transpose(-1, -2).contiguous().transpose(-1, -2)
+        self.assertTrue(_conv_multi_eligible([(got_multi, src)]))
+        fused_conv_window_scatter_multi([(got_multi, src)], dst_idx, step_idx)
+        get_device_module().synchronize()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(got_single, expect, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(got_multi, expect, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
     def test_strided_envelope_commit_and_track(self):
         """Outer strides must not disable fusion or overwrite adjacent state."""
         layers, slots, batch, steps = 3, 16, 5, 4
@@ -494,8 +520,8 @@ def test_strided_envelope_commit_and_track(self):
         step2 = torch.tensor([1, 2, -1], device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32)

+        self.assertTrue(
